name: Specification far from the code
problem: A person reading the code of a solution cannot find its specification without leaving the code tree: the records sit in a separate folder, a code folder carries no page that says what it is for, and a change to the code and to its spec happen in two places.
who_has_it: People and AI agents who open a code folder and want to know why it exists, and who edit the code and then must find its record.
why_it_matters: A spec that is hard to find from the code goes stale, and code with no visible reason stays after its reason is gone.
why_hard: Cross-cutting problems and ideals have no single code folder; the records must still be checked as one tree; moving files must not break the network.
existing_attempts: All records in one esoi folder; a hand-written README in each code folder.

name: Who reviewed a record is not recorded
problem: A record does not say whether a person reviewed it or the AI kept it, so a program that changes structure is told by its caller which records a person owns, and a record nobody told it about may be changed as if it were the AI's.
who_has_it: Programs and AI agents that change records, and the people who own them.
why_it_matters: A change to a record a person wrote or reviewed must reach that person as a proposal; the safe default is that every record is a person's until it says otherwise.
why_hard: The mark must live with the record and survive edits, an unmarked record must stay a person's, and the same mark must serve every kind of record.
existing_attempts: The caller passes the marks in with the structure.
